newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: LA Retail says earnings on track.
newsitem.headline: LA Retail says earnings on track.

text.p: Recently listed LA Retail Stores was well on track to meet projected earnings in the current financial year, financial director Showkat Mukadam said on Tuesday.
Speaking at the group's first annual general meeting, Mukadam said that LA had experienced good turnover growth during the festive season and that a busy winter retail season was expected this year.
LA has projected a turnover of 44 million rand in 1997 and earnings of 4.13 million rand.

Mukadam said that although LA's summer merchandise produced higher sales volumes, the higher-priced winter garments would provide better turnover margins. It specialises in fashion clothing for the young.

"Although certain retailers have been affected by a slight drop in purchasing patterns, our niche products have obtained a high level of interest amongst our customers, which translates into steady growth," he said.
The Samson brand name previously owned by Ensign Clothing would be revived this year and this move towards durable work-wear was expected to contribute quickly to bottom-line earnings.
Four of the six new stores planned this year had already been opened, bringing to 21 the total number of stores countrywide.

"We foresee an opportunity to establish a nationwide chain of more than 50 stores, of which about two-thirds will be located in major metropolitan centres and one-third in the more affluent country towns," Mukadam said.
